body: Fishing line can be annoying. But they work on the fountains (the blue thing that appear on the map that you use to recover HP), so when they spawn near your place just leave them there to fish when you want.

author: permaculturegeek
body:
Fixing this is within your power:
1) Sign up as an editor at openstreetmap.org
2) Learn to edit
3) Alter that stream so that instead of being represented as a polyline (a series of line segments and/or bezier curves) with zero width, it is a closed shape filled with "water". I.e. draw both banks. Be accurate or you may be banned.
4) Wait for your edits to be approved 
5) Wait six months or more for Northern Forge to update the OSM dataset they use.. Water creatures will spawn if the game sees water.
6) Fish

Worth doing if this is by your OT or somewhere else you play a lot, but such places often accumulate a lot of fountains anyway.
